title: A filter over ALL ( col1, col2 ) overrides the existing filters on those columns
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Columns filter] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], FILTER ( ALL ( 'Product'[Color], 'Product'[Category] ), 'Product'[Color] = "Blue" || 'Product'[Category] = "Vehicles" ) )

source.quote: The result of this filter will override any existing filter over the specified columns.
source.supports: a filter built on ALL of the columns overrides any existing filter over them

derivation: ALL ( Color, Category ) has the existing combinations (Red, Vehicles), (Red, Accessories), (Blue, Accessories), (Green, Vehicles). Blue or Vehicles keeps (Red, Vehicles), (Blue, Accessories), (Green, Vehicles): Bike, Lock, Scooter. This filter replaces the row's Category filter: 400 + 80 + BLANK = 480 on both rows.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
